name: City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, August 01, 2017 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Waronek
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
A.
Introduction of Sister City Takaishi Japan Students
B.
Railroad Museum Board Update
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-d, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of July 18, 2017
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Los Angeles County Social Program Agreement for $2,500 contribution to the City's Parks and Recreation Programs
ACTION: Staff recommends entering into a Social Program Agreement with the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors.
Item #7d
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
CONSIDERATION OF APPOINTMENT OF VOTING DELEGATE FOR THE LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CONFERENCE - SEPTEMBER 13-15,2017 IN SACRAMENTO
Presented by City Manager Smoot
ACTION: That the City Council appoint ______________ as the voting delegate and ________________ as the alternate voting delegate for the League of California Conference Business meeting at the League of California Conference.
Item #8
9.
SELECTION OF A DATE FOR THE RETAIL ANALYSIS AND DOWNTOWN STRATEGY ACTION: That the City Council select September 12th or September 26th as the date to discuss the Retail Analysis and Downtown Strategy.
10.
CONSIDERATION AND POSSIBLE RE-APPOINTMENTS AND APPOINTMENTS TO THE FOLLOWING COMMISSIONS/BOARDS.
Presented by City Manager Smoot
a.
One vacancy on the Planning Commission
b.
Two vacancies on the Parks & Recreation Commission
c.
Two expired terms on the Planning Commission
d.
One expired term on the Public Safety & Traffic Commission
e.
One expired term on the Railroad Museum Board.
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council appoint candidates to the Planning Commission, Public Safety and Traffic Commission, Parks and Recreation Commission, and the Railroad Museum Board.
11.
CONSIDERATION OF AN INSPECTION SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH LOS ANGELES COUNTY DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH FOR MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENTS
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
RES 2017-30 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER OR DESIGNEE, TO ENTER INTO AN MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENT INSPECTION SERVICES AGREEMENT TO ALLOW THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH'S (DPH) ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH DIVISION TO PROVIDE HEALTH AND SANITATION INSPECTIONS OF MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENTS FOR THE CITY AND AMENDING THE MASTER FEE SCHEDULE TO INCREASE THE FEE FOR ANNUAL MASSAGE BUSINESS LICENSES.
Item #11
12.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF REQUEST TO RESTRIPE A PORTION OF NARBONNE AVENUE
Presented by Public Works Director McAvoy
ACTION: Staff and Public Traffic and Safety Commission recommend that:
1)
Approve Nelson/Nygaard's recommendation to reconfigure the traffic striping on the portion of Narbonne Avenue between Pacific Coast Highway and Lomita Boulevard to include a single lane in each direction, center turn lane, bicycle lanes, and parking per the attached memorandum; and
2)
Direct staff to incorporate the changes into the current Narbonne Avenue Pavement Rehabilitation Project. Lomita City Council Meeting Agenda0August 1, 2017
Item #12
13.
CONSIDERATION AND POSSIBLE APPROVAL OF A CONTRACT FOR CROSSING GUARDS SERVICES WITH ALL CITY MANAGEMENT SERVICES
Presented by Management Analyst Vander Neut
ACTION: That the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute a three-year contract with All City Management Services for crossing guard services in an amount not to exceed $57,413 in year one; $63,440 in year two; and $70,470 in year three.
Item #13
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
14.
PUBLIC HEARING - PROPOSITION 218 RELATIVE TO SOLID WASTE RATES
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
RES 2017-31 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, INCREASING SOLID WASTE COLLECTION FEES.
ACTION: That the protest hearing be held to accept testimony and written protests against the increased fees; ask City Clerk to tabulate the protests. If the number of written protests received is not sufficient to constitute a majority protests, make a finding that there is no majority protest by property owners within the assessment area; and approve said resolution.
Item #14
15.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, August 15, 2017, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in the City Hall lobby and bulletin board, and posted on the City's website not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. A copy of said Agenda is on file in the Office of the City Clerk.
Dated this 27th Day of July 2017
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
